payload.name: Extract Explicitly Named Media Titles with Engagement
payload.description: When a message names a specific game, movie, show, book, or other media title and states the user is playing, watching, or reading it, create a durable memory for that title even if the message contains other topics.
content: During extraction, if a message explicitly names a game, movie, TV show, book, or other media title and states the user is playing, watching, reading, or otherwise engaged with it, create a separate durable preference or event memory for that title with subject=user and world_start set to the message date.
Create one candidate per explicitly named media title; do not merge the title only into a general hobby, relationship, or other-topic candidate.

Include any intensity or temporal detail the user stated (e.g., 'nonstop', 'recently') when it is part of the claim, and stop once all explicitly named media titles in the message are captured—do not infer unmentioned titles.

solves: During candidate extraction, when a user names a specific game, movie, show, book, or other media title and describes playing, watching, or reading it, the construction agent sometimes skips creating a memory for that title when the same message also contains other extractable facts. This skill ensures each explicitly named media title with engagement is captured as its own durable memory.
